asset.coordinateSystem: glTF Y-up, +Z-forward, +X-own-left; native height approximately one unit

equipment: Two independent machine-gun assemblies; torso-owned brackets remain when slots are empty. Kestrel B/C use procedural models.
motion: Shipping clips retain the approved draft animation samples. Runtime uses measured fixed-step contacts/IK and Kestrel-specific stride/run parameters, visually approved separately.
collision: Existing simulation-owned gameplay collision proxies remain; visual triangles are not added as physics colliders.
lighting: Existing dynamic game lighting; opaque palette with embedded base-color and metallic/roughness textures.
lod: Single approved geometry level. No universal crowd budget or hardware performance acceptance is inferred.
